issue: Blocked task cannot be edited at all — description and priority are not modifiable
actual: For blocked tasks (e.g. "Complete tax filing", "Submit final report", "QA Alpha Task") the Edit button is fully disabled (button.disabled=true), so the edit form cannot be opened. Enumerating every interactive element inside the blocked task card returns only complete (disabled), edit (disabled) and delete (enabled) — there is no inline or alternative control for description or priority. The requirement that a blocked task still allows changing description and priority (while blocking title and deadline) is therefore unmet.

issue: Reopening a prerequisite leaves the dependent task simultaneously completed and blocked, and permanently un-reopenable
actual: Completed "Review project proposal" (prereq) and "Complete tax filing" (dependent), then reopened the prerequisite. The reopen was allowed and the dependent was NOT returned to an incomplete state: "Complete tax filing" still sits in the Completed view (counted in "Completed 3", complete toggle state="completed") while simultaneously rendering the blocked warning 'Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete' with complete.enabled=false and edit.enabled=false. The task is therefore in the contradictory completed+blocked state the constraint forbids, and because its complete toggle is now disabled it cannot be reopened either.
